scenes.text: Watch and read: Ama asks: What is the purpose of a recipe?
The answer is: explain how to cook. Different kinds of texts have different purposes.
Watch and read: For your storyparts practice, read: “Ama found a red ball at the playground. Ama gave it back to Kojo. The day ended happily.” Who is the main character?
The answer is: Ama. The character is the person the story is about.
